summary: KalVista Pharmaceuticals entered into a definitive merger agreement with Chiesi Farmaceutici S.p.A. on April 29, 2026. Chiesi will cause its subsidiary to commence a tender offer for all outstanding shares at $27.00 per share in cash. The offer must be commenced within 10 business days and will expire 20 business days later, subject to extension. Conditions include a minimum tender of over 50% of outstanding shares, HSR clearance, German antitrust approval, and Italian foreign investment clearance. The company's board likely recommends the deal. Watch for regulatory timelines and any competing bids.
